Cara: Quick draft for tomorrow's 02:00 UTC change window. Keeping internal + public variants below. Ops: please confirm runbook and who will execute the pin.

Cara: ```
Release v2.3.1 (patch)
- Fix: dispatcher memory leak under burst load (fewer OOMs on high concurrency)
- Tune: KV cache heuristics adjusted (~12% token cost reduction on chat workloads)
- Ops: canary pin with auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if p99 latency >200ms for 10m
- Impact: no API changes; SDK patch-level bump only
```

Omar: Solid. Two asks: include exact CLI snippets (pin + rollback) and a single-line rollback criteria for the internal note.

Cara: Added:
- Internal pin: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal --actor @Omar`
- Public pin (flip): `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope public --actor @Ben`
- Rollback CLI: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms_10m"`
- Rollback criteria (short): sustained p99 >200ms for 10m OR error rate >3x baseline

Ben: Ops runbook (condensed):
1) T-30m: post internal announce (detailed runbook + CLI snippets)
2) T0 (02:00 UTC): run internal pin (Omar) and start automated health checks
3) Watch p50/p95/p99, error rate, and host OOMs for 10m
4) If stable, wait 90m then run public pin and trigger public blurb (Cara to post)
5) If rollback criteria hit, run rollback CLI and open #incident with short reason

ops-oncall: Roster: @ops-oncall (primary), @Hector (backup). I'll cover 01:50-04:00 UTC and monitor latency dashboards. I'll create the incident channel if criteria are met.

Cara: For comms: internal note includes the CLI and runbook. Public blurb: "Stability patch to improve service reliability; no customer action required." Keep it non-technical.

Omar: I'll execute the internal pin and monitor. If I need to rollback, I'll post the rollback CLI and the immediate reason in this thread.

deploy-bot: Deploybot scheduled: window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, duration=30m, change-id=ch_998765, canary=true, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Ben: PR with both blurb variants: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/460. Please review by EOD. I'll post internal announce at T-30m unless ops wants to post.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Roster and monitor confirmed.

Cara: Thanks all. Locking thread for prep. Re-open if last-minute edits.
